We were saddened late in November to learn from Win Shepherd that her mother had died recently in hospital. Mrs Savage was in her 80's and had not enjoyed good health over the last few years.

I hope to see you at Battersea Park - I will be in the recording caravan as usual Win Shepherd (Immediate Past President), Wimbledon.
Just over a year ago Win Shepherd became the first Lady President in the club's 104 year history - after an apprenticeship as President's Lady in 1962.
